interview.answer: The repair drive is still awaiting a final time and will be at the garage.

reflections: Bo is coordinating practical, hands-on help and keeps commitments straightforward.
Leo and Opal respond with brief confirmations, suggesting low-friction collaboration.
The group is aligning around shared physical meetups at specific places and times.
Bo is consistently responsive and organized, often offering to bring basics, keep tools ready, and head over when available.
The group relies on lightweight coordination through status updates, with Mara and Faye both emphasizing keeping people posted as details change.
Logistics are still unsettled, especially the address and timing, so participants are waiting on confirmations before committing fully.
Bo is coordinating hands-on help at the garage and is keeping others updated rather than acting alone.
Faye is managing uncertainty about timing/address details and tends to confirm before moving.
The group is responsive and collaborative, with people offering to bring basics, head over, and ask where to start.
Bo is coordinating logistics and expects timely updates before heading to the garage.
Dane is proactively helping and aligning with the garage cleanup plan.
Uli is handling scheduling details and keeping others informed once the final time is set.
Bo is cooperative and prefers waiting for a final time before acting, suggesting he wants coordination to stay simple and clear.
Dane is taking on the more physical/logistical part of the task by sorting and hauling broken items to the garage.
Leo appears to be coordinating the broader flow and keeping Bo informed if anything changes.
